title: Ueber die Anzahl der Primzahlen unter einer gegebenen Grösse

definitions.statement: zeta(s) = sum_{n=1}^infinity n^(-s) = prod_p (1 - p^(-s))^(-1) for Re(s) > 1, analytically continued to C \\ {1}.
xi(s) = 1/2 s(s-1) pi^(-s/2) Gamma(s/2) zeta(s), entire function of order 1.

theorems.label: Functional Equation
theorems.statement: xi(s) = xi(1-s), equivalent to zeta(s) = 2^s pi^(s-1) sin(pi s / 2) Gamma(1-s) zeta(1-s).

theorems.label: Hadamard Product Formula
theorems.statement: xi(s) = xi(0) prod_rho (1 - s/rho) over non-trivial zeros rho with Re(rho) in (0,1).

theorems.label: Explicit Formula
theorems.statement: f(x) = Li(x) - sum_rho Li(x^rho) + integral_x^infinity dt / (t(t^2-1) log t) - log 2.

conjectures.label: Riemann Hypothesis
conjectures.statement: All non-trivial zeros of zeta(s) have real part Re(s) = 1/2.

open_gaps: Riemann's hand calculations gave the first three zeros (14.1347, 21.0220, 25.0108) on Re(s)=1/2 but could not prove global confinement.
Non-vanishing of zeta(s) for Re(s) in (1/2, 1) remains completely unproven across the continuum.
computational_handles: Riemann-Siegel formula for Z(t) and theta(t) with Gram points t_n.
Euler-Maclaurin summation for high-precision zeta(s) in the critical strip.
Truncated explicit formula prime counting verification against counted pi(x).
